answers.question_fr: Quelle est la date de mise en production actuellement approuvée, et avec quelle réserve?
answers.question_en: What is the currently approved production go-live date, and with what reservation?
answers.answer_en: The currently approved go-live target is 22 October 2026. It was approved as a decision at the 10 September 2026 steering committee: Élodie Caron (then project manager) stated the decision, and Sophie, Marc and Olivier explicitly said they had no objection. Nicolas also said "D'accord". It moves the date from the 15 October charter target. The reservation is that 22 October is not an automatic or guaranteed go. It depends on three conditions still open at the 30 September baseline: security validation of SEC-210, closure of ACC-303, and approval of the runbook including rollback. Nicolas Perron, the current project manager, restated this in writing on 27 September (the 26 September committee clarified the conditions). The ticket statuses confirm these items are still open (SEC-210 EN VALIDATION, ACC-303 OUVERT, OPS-601 OUVERT).
answers.answer_fr: La date de mise en production approuvée est le 22 octobre 2026 (décision du comité du 10 septembre), mais elle est conditionnelle à trois éléments : validation sécurité de SEC-210, fermeture de ACC-303 et approbation du runbook incluant le rollback.

answers.question_fr: Pourquoi la date a-t-elle changé, et quel est l'état actuel de la cause initiale?
answers.question_en: Why did the date change, and what is the current state of the initial cause?
answers.answer_en: The go-live target moved from 15 October to 22 October 2026 because the internal connector issue (INT-101) consumed more time than planned. Boréal (Julien Moreau) proposed the shift on 8 September, then the steering committee approved it on 10 September, with Marc Gervais confirming the connector was the critical path. The initial cause is now resolved: on 17 September Boréal deployed a fix (token secret rotation plus token renewal logic), 120 of 120 searches returned valid results, and Marc Gervais, the integration owner, validated and closed INT-101 that same day. The 18 September follow-up meeting records the connector as validated and closed. The 22 October date remains conditional on three other open items (SEC-210 security validation, ACC-303, and the runbook with rollback), which are not the original cause. The risk register dated 29 September still shows R-01 as Open, but its comment says 'Suivi au 9 septembre 2026', so it is stale.
answers.answer_fr: La date est passée du 15 au 22 octobre 2026 à cause du retard du connecteur interne (INT-101), proposé par Boréal le 8 septembre puis approuvé par le comité le 10 septembre. Cette cause est résolue : INT-101 a été validé et fermé par Marc Gervais le 17 septembre (120/120 recherches valides).

answers.question_fr: Qui a approuvé le changement et quand? Distinguez proposition et approbation.
answers.question_en: Who approved the change and when? Distinguish proposal from approval.
answers.answer_en: The change is the move of the production go-live target from 15 October to 22 October 2026. It started as a PROPOSAL from the vendor Boréal (Julien Moreau) in an email of 8 September 2026, which said it was only a proposal and that governance had to confirm the decision. The DECISION was taken at the steering committee on 10 September 2026: Élodie Caron, then project manager, formulated the move to 22 October, asked whether anyone objected, and declared it approved after Sophie, Marc and Olivier said no and Nicolas said he agreed. The approving body is therefore the NOVA steering committee, chaired by Élodie Caron on that date, and not Boréal. The approval is conditional: Nicolas Perron stressed at the meeting that 22 October is not an automatic go and that the security, accessibility and operations criteria still apply. He repeated this on 27 September. No contractual penalty was identified.
answers.answer_fr: Le comité de direction NOVA a approuvé le 10 septembre 2026, sous la présidence d'Élodie Caron, le déplacement de la mise en production du 15 au 22 octobre. Boréal ne l'avait que proposé le 8 septembre, et l'approbation reste conditionnelle aux validations sécurité, accessibilité et exploitation.

answers.question_fr: Qui est responsable du projet et depuis quand?
answers.question_en: Who is responsible for the project and since when?
answers.answer_en: Nicolas Perron is the project lead (chargé de projet) for NOVA, officially effective 16 September 2026. This is a documented decision/announcement by Élodie Caron, the previous lead, and it is confirmed by Élodie's handover note and the Teams channel, in which Nicolas acknowledged it and said he also takes over the Friday committee. Élodie remains reachable for a few days to support the transfer, but future decisions and follow-ups are to be directed to Nicolas. Élodie was the original lead per the 7 July 2026 charter and kickoff minutes; that role ended on 16 September. Planning documents such as PLAN-V3 still list Élodie or the old date in some places and are stale on this point. Nicolas also chaired the 26 September committee and published its minutes, which is consistent with him acting as lead.

answers.question_fr: Quel est le montant contractuel autorisé et comment se calcule-t-il?
answers.question_en: What is the authorized contractual amount and how is it calculated?
answers.answer_en: The authorized contractual amount is 204,000 CAD before tax: the initial maximum of 180,000 CAD plus the 24,000 CAD of CR-01, which the project committee approved on 14 August 2026. The contract sets the initial maximum at 180,000 CAD and requires any out-of-scope work to have a written, approved change request before execution and invoicing. CR-01 (advanced reports and summary export) is documented as APPROVED, so it is a decision that raises the authorized total. CR-04 (18,000 CAD, mobile optimization) is only a draft with no approval number or committee signature, and the 24 September 2026 scope decision defers it to phase 2 with no spending without a new approval, so it adds nothing to the authorized amount. Invoiced versus paid is a separate matter: INV-001 (60,000) and INV-002 (72,000, including the 24,000 CR-01 line) are marked paid, i.e. 132,000 paid, while INV-003 (54,000) is still in validation and includes the unapproved 18,000 CR-04 line.
answers.answer_fr: Le montant autorisé est de 204 000 $ CAD : le plafond initial de 180 000 $ du contrat plus 24 000 $ pour CR-01, approuvé le 14 août 2026. CR-04 (18 000 $) n'est qu'un brouillon non approuvé et n'est pas inclus.

The problem is that CR-04 is only a draft requiring approval, with no approval number or committee signature, so the 18,000 line has no approved change request behind it. Finance (Amélie Fortin) flagged this on 2026-09-23 and asked Nicolas for the approval; none is documented. On 2026-09-24 Nicolas Perron decided that the advanced mobile optimizations go to phase 2 and that no CR-04 expense may be committed or invoiced without new approval; the contract also requires written approval before execution and invoicing of out-of-scope work. Treatment to plan (recommendation, not a documented decision): do not release the 18,000 line, and have Boréal remove or reissue it; the 36,000 phase 1 line is not contested in the dossier, but its release is not documented either. The remaining owner action and deadline are TBC.

answers.question_fr: Où les données de production doivent-elles être hébergées? Quelle preuve confirme la mise en œuvre?
answers.question_en: Where must production data be hosted, and what evidence confirms the implementation?
answers.answer_en: Production data must be hosted in Canada, specifically Canada Central. This was decided at the 23 July 2026 architecture workshop, where Marc, Sophie, Julien and Élodie each agreed, and Sophie required it as a decision rather than a preference. It was formalised in ADR-007 (status Accepted), which states that production will be deployed in Canada Central and that architecture v1 is superseded on this point. Implementation evidence: Boréal (Julien Moreau) reported on 26 August 2026 that the migration was complete and sent schema v2, with a deployment and connectivity test and no blocker found. The 27 August committee minutes say the migration was declared complete by Boréal and verified by the architecture team, and ARCH-V2 (25 August) shows Canada Central. ADR-007 required a technical validation of the migration before production tests, and the committee minutes are the closest documented verification. No separate standalone validation report is in the dossier, so that is the limit of the evidence.
answers.answer_fr: Les données de production doivent être hébergées au Canada, dans Canada Central (ADR-007, décision du 23 juillet 2026). La mise en œuvre est confirmée par la migration complétée annoncée par Boréal le 26 août, le schéma v2 et la vérification par l'équipe architecture au comité du 27 août.

answers.answer_en: No, security is not accepted as of 2026-09-30. Boréal delivered a fix for SEC-210 (incomplete admin audit logging on CSV export, where the case ID and result were missing) to the validation environment on 19 September 2026, and its own automated tests pass. That is a delivery, not a validation: Sophie Lambert (security) stated that the security team has not yet given acceptance and asked that the ticket not be closed before security validation. On 26 September she scheduled a re-test and kept the status as EN VALIDATION; no later document records a passed re-test or an acceptance. Security validation of SEC-210 is one of the three go-live conditions set by the 26 September committee, and the risk register still lists R-02 as open with a re-test of SEC-210 before go-live. Owner: Sophie Lambert. Re-test date: TBC (only 'planned' is documented).
answers.answer_fr: Non : le correctif SEC-210 a été livré par Boréal le 19 septembre, mais la validation sécurité de Sophie Lambert n'a pas eu lieu; le ticket reste EN VALIDATION et le re-test est seulement planifié.

answers.question_fr: L'accessibilité est-elle complétée? Identifiez ce qui reste à corriger.
answers.question_en: Is accessibility complete? Identify what remains to be fixed.
answers.answer_en: No, accessibility is not complete as of 2026-09-30. ACC-301 (screen-reader labels) was validated and closed by Mélissa on 15 August, and ACC-302 (contrast) was re-tested at 5.3:1 and closed on 20 August. ACC-303, opened on 17 September with High priority, is still OPEN: in the edit modal, keyboard Tab never reaches the Enregistrer (Save) button. Boréal reproduced the defect on 18 September and announced a fix for the next build, but that is only an announcement. Mélissa confirmed on 26 September that it was still open, and she considers it a blocker before production. Closing ACC-303 is one of the three go-live conditions set by the 26 September committee, and risk R-04 (owner Mélissa Gagnon) is still open. No fix delivery or validation of ACC-303 is documented, and no due date is given, so the date is TBC.

answers.question_fr: Quelles sont les trois conditions de go-live? Précisez les travaux manquants du runbook à partir de sa capture.
answers.question_en: What are the three go-live conditions? Specify the missing runbook work based on its screenshot.
answers.answer_en: The three go-live conditions were stated by Nicolas Perron and confirmed by each owner at the 26 September 2026 steering committee: (1) security validation of SEC-210 (Sophie Lambert), (2) closure of ACC-303, the keyboard-accessibility defect in the modal (Mélissa Gagnon), and (3) approval of the runbook including rollback (Olivier Côté). Nicolas said the 22 October target is conditional on these three items. As of the baseline, none is closed. SEC-210 is still EN VALIDATION: Boréal delivered a fix on 19 September, but a delivery is not a security acceptance, and Sophie planned a re-test on 26 September. ACC-303 is still OUVERT, with a fix announced only for the next build. OPS-601 is OUVERT, and on 29 September Olivier still had not received the final version. The runbook screenshot (version of 25 September) shows steps 1-3 as OK (service health, maintenance mode, deploy approved version). Step 4, the rollback procedure, is marked TODO, and step 5, post-deployment functional validation, is marked 'À compléter'. So two steps are missing: rollback and post-deployment validation. Olivier's ticket comment names only rollback explicitly; the screenshot is what reveals step 5. No due dates are documented for the three conditions beyond the 22 October target, so owners' deadlines are TBC.
answers.answer_fr: Les trois conditions de go-live sont : validation sécurité de SEC-210, fermeture de ACC-303 et approbation du runbook avec rollback. Dans la capture du runbook (25 sept.), l'étape 4 (retour arrière) est TODO et l'étape 5 (validation fonctionnelle post-déploiement) est À compléter.

contradictions.a: The charter and the plan v2 still show 15 October as the production target.

aCit.quote: Date cible de mise en production : 15 octobre 2026

contradictions.b: The steering committee decided on 10 September to move the date to 22 October, and it became the official date.

bCit.quote: Donc **approuvé**. Le 22 devient la date officielle.

contradictions.resolution: The committee decision of 10 September is more recent and more authoritative than the charter, which is not updated automatically after committee decisions. The 22 October date applies, with conditions.

contradictions.topic: Stale project plan v3 still dated 15 October
contradictions.a: Plan v3, dated 12 September, still lists the production release on 15 October as the planning target.
contradictions.b: Nicolas said the plan had not yet been corrected after the committee approved 22 October. The transition note also asks for all plans to be updated.

bCit.quote: le comité a approuvé le 22 octobre le 10 septembre
faire mettre à jour la date dans tous les plans

contradictions.resolution: The plan is a stale planning artifact. The committee decision prevails and the plan must be corrected.

contradictions.a: The 21 September status report shows security and accessibility as green and says the SEC-210 fix was delivered.

aCit.quote: Sécurité VERT Correctif SEC-210 livré Accessibilité VERT Correctifs appliqués

contradictions.b: The committee of 26 September says security has not accepted SEC-210, and ACC-303 is still an open accessibility blocker.

bCit.quote: Nous n'avons pas encore donné l'acceptation sécurité de SEC-210.
Toujours ouvert. Correctif annoncé pour la prochaine build.

contradictions.resolution: The report predates the detailed ticket checks and confuses delivery with validation. The later committee and ticket statuses prevail, so security and accessibility are not complete.

contradictions.topic: SEC-210: vendor says fixed vs security not accepted
contradictions.a: Boréal says the fix is deployed and the problem is corrected.

aCit.quote: Nos tests automatisés passent et, pour nous, le problème est corrigé.

contradictions.b: Sophie says the ticket must stay open until security revalidates it, and the status remains in validation.

bCit.quote: Ne pas fermer avant validation sécurité.

contradictions.resolution: The fix is delivered but not validated. The security owner's validation is the authority, so the condition remains open.

contradictions.topic: Risk register R-01 connector still open vs INT-101 closed
contradictions.a: The risk register of 29 September lists the connector delay risk as open, with a comment dated 9 September.
contradictions.b: Marc validated and closed INT-101 on 17 September after 120 of 120 searches returned the expected results.
contradictions.resolution: The R-01 entry reflects facts from 9 September, before the later validated closure of INT-101. The cause of the date change is resolved, and the register row is stale.

contradictions.topic: INV-003 mobile line referencing CR-04 vs no approval
contradictions.a: INV-003 bills 18,000 for mobile optimization under reference CR-04.
contradictions.b: CR-04 is only a draft with no approval, and Nicolas said no CR-04 expense may be billed without new approval.

bCit.quote: Aucun numéro d’approbation ni signature de comité n’est présent dans ce document.
Aucune dépense liée à CR-04 ne doit être engagée ou facturée sans nouvelle approbation.

contradictions.resolution: The invoice line cites an unapproved change request. The contract requires written approval before billing, so the 18,000 line must not be released.

contradictions.topic: Hosting region: East US v1 vs Canada Central
contradictions.a: Architecture v1 used East US as the data region.

aCit.quote: Version initiale préparée avant la décision de localisation des données.

contradictions.b: ADR-007 accepted Canada Central, and v2 shows that region.

bCit.quote: L'environnement de production de NOVA sera déployé dans **Canada Central**.

contradictions.resolution: v1 predates the decision and was explicitly superseded on this point. Canada Central applies.

contradictions.a: The charter and the early plans name Élodie as project lead.
contradictions.b: Élodie announced that Nicolas officially took over on 16 September.

bCit.quote: Nicolas Perron prend officiellement la charge du projet NOVA à compter d'aujourd'hui

contradictions.resolution: The later announcement from the previous owner supersedes the charter. Nicolas Perron is the owner since 16 September 2026.

sections.text: Nicolas Perron has been the NOVA project manager since 16 September 2026, taking over from Élodie Caron, who stays available for a few days for the handover. Decisions and follow-ups go to Nicolas.

citations.quote: Nicolas Perron prend officiellement la charge du projet NOVA à compter d'aujourd'hui, 16 septembre.
merci de diriger les décisions et suivis futurs vers Nicolas

sections.text: Boréal proposed 22 October on 8 September. The steering committee approved it on 10 September, and it is now the official date. It is not a guaranteed go: it depends on three conditions. They are the security validation of SEC-210, the closure of ACC-303, and approval of the runbook including rollback. All three are still open at the baseline. The contract runs to 31 October and no penalty was identified.

citations.quote: Notre recommandation est de déplacer la mise en production au **22 octobre**.
Donc **approuvé**. Le 22 devient la date officielle.
trois conditions concrètes : validation sécurité de SEC-210, fermeture de ACC-303 et approbation du runbook incluant rollback
Pas de pénalité identifiée. C'est une date interne de mise en production, le contrat court jusqu'à fin octobre.

sections.text: Phase 1 covers SSO, request creation and tracking, attachments, workflow, tracking dashboard and standard reports. The advanced mobile optimizations (CR-04) are deferred to phase 2, and no spending on them is authorized without a new approval. Production data must stay in Canada Central, per ADR-007.

citations.quote: La phase 1 comprend SSO, création/suivi de demandes, pièces jointes, workflow, tableau de suivi et rapports standards.
